purpose: Teach: 難病/治ら/力不足/カオス/始まら/危うい/宛先/叶わ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: CSR、難病団体への寄付、増額しろ。
lines.en: Increase the CSR donation to rare-disease organizations.
lines.style: Clipped, direct. Authority is in the brevity. Businesslike attack. No room for question—just the order, delivered clean.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の家族、治らない病、抱えている方も。
lines.en: Yes. Some of our staff have family members dealing with incurable illness.
lines.style: Steady, thoughtful. Respectful acknowledgment of what the boss has said. Measured pace. Shows he's heard the human weight in this decision, not just the line item.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 人事、力不足な点、見直せ。
lines.en: HR needs to review where they're falling short.
lines.style: Firm, commanding. The word 'review' lands with weight. No elaboration needed—the implication is clear. Composed, exacting.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。業界全体がカオスに陥らないよう、努めます。
lines.en: Yes. I'll make sure we don't let the whole industry slide into chaos.
lines.style: Quiet intensity. He's making a bigger promise than the surface instruction. Slow, grounded. Shows he understands what's actually at stake here.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 新プロジェクト、まだ始まらないが、準備、急げ。
lines.en: The new project hasn't launched yet, but we need to accelerate preparations.
lines.style: Brisk, matter-of-fact. Forward-leaning energy. The instruction is an edge—move faster. No tolerance for lag time. Composed impatience.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。資金、危うい時期もありましたが、安定しました。
lines.en: Yes. The funding situation was shaky for a while, but we've stabilized it.
lines.style: Grounded, somewhat weary. Shows he's lived through the precarious moment. Speaks with the relief of someone who fixed something difficult. Clear-eyed, not boasting.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 送付物、宛先、二重チェックを。
lines.en: Make sure you double-check all mailing addresses.
lines.style: Precise, no-nonsense. This is small but it matters—precision prevents mistakes that embarrass the company. Quiet insistence. Delivered like something learned from experience.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の夢、少しでも叶わせる、配慮します。
lines.en: Yes. I'll make sure we're doing right by our people's hopes, even in small ways.
lines.style: Soft finish, genuine. He's moved past procedural—this is about care now. Slower, more personal. The word 'dreams' gentles his voice. He means this.
